scope: Reconcile ODA R2004 page-field semantics, LibreDWG's current AC1032 trailing-page report and proposed fix, and libdxfrw's production reader/test seam; update existing plan owners without declaring an unverified local defect.

method.kind: Authoritative ODA PDF sections 4.5-4.7, current primary peer issue/PR, read-only local source and test audit
method.evidenceBoundary: The ODA document is the normative source for the local DWG wire-format audit. LibreDWG and ACadSharp issue/PR text are peer reports and proposed-branch evidence only. Static local field-role comparison identifies a high-priority candidate mismatch; no runtime reproduction or local defect declaration is made.

evidence.topic: ODA R2004 section and page fields are distinct quantities
observed: The section description separately stores logical section Size, count of pages actually written, and Max Decompressed Size per page; zero-only pages can be omitted and represented by start-offset gaps.

The global SectionPageMap page size and masked data-page header field at offset 0x0C are physical file extents. The masked header's Data size at 0x08 is the stored payload length/checksum span; for compressed pages it is compressed bytes, and for uncompressed pages it is the full padded page image.

The final stored page is physically padded to a full page, but only min(page-size, section-size minus logical start offset) bytes are part of the logical section. Page-map array order/start offsets determine positioning; physical page bounds and logical section bounds must not be conflated.
evidence.confidence: Authoritative format specification; the section and masked page-header records are explicit, while real-file conformance still needs a local generated control.

evidence.topic: Candidate local R2004+ page-header field-role mismatch and missing direct coverage
observed: The R2004+ production path reads masked-header offset 0x0C into pi.uSize, logs it as decompressed page size, compares it to decodedPageCap, and for compressed==1 requires cSize==uSize.
ODA §4.6 identifies offset 0x0C as physical Page Size, while offset 0x08 is Data size; dwgPageInfo's header comment currently scopes uSize to R2007/reader21.
The global page map supplies physical page extent in pi.size, but the reviewed production path does not directly assert that the masked-header physical Page Size matches that map extent.

Existing sectionBufferCapacity tests validate arithmetic only. The existing reader-matrix test subclass overrides parseDataPage and supplies decoded bytes, so it does not execute the production R2004+ page parser.
evidence.planAction: Under existing PAR-14/7BE, create a source-generated test that reaches the production parseDataPage implementation and gives distinct values to physical extent, stored payload size, per-section page capacity, total logical section size, and final-page padding. First verify the local version/page-map path against ODA; only then decide whether field naming, validation, or decode bounds need a production fix.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG AC1032 compressed-section failure and proposed fix status
observed: Issue #1294 now describes four AC1032 failures from varied drawing histories and one passing control; a public reproducer and two additional public files were reported, while another failing file remained confidential.

The PR author attributes the peer failure to allocating from a page-count estimate that can undershoot declared decompressed section size and to using a section-wide maximum rather than the page's actual remaining span in the final-page guard.

The reporter says its public samples matched ODA File Converter 25.6 after the proposed patch; the original reporter also reported their own file changing from zero to 83,917 objects and no output changes on 91 other files in a 92-file set.

As retrieved on 2026-10-17, PR #1358 remains open and carries the cla_needed label. The issue author reports success with the patch, but the change is unmerged/unreleased peer evidence, not current-master or package capability.
evidence.planAction: Use only as a failure-shape lead. Do not download/vendor its DWGs or transplant peer field meanings. Test the same classes of physical/logical boundary with locally authored in-memory page records and the ODA-defined local layout. Keep this distinct from LibreDWG #1355 handle-map and converter-finalization reports.

evidence.topic: Independent DXF parser hostile-run signal already owned by local tests
evidence.observed: The still-open ACadSharp report describes recursive processing for long comment runs, repeated XDATA application blocks, and consecutive IMAGE/WIPEOUT clip groups, with ASCII and Binary paths sharing some recursive helpers. It is a peer-specific failure, not a local defect or a format maximum.
evidence.planAction: Retain the existing PAR-14/PAR-26/7BA/7S hostile-run controls and their no-recursion/forward-progress assertions; this review does not add duplicate stress cases or copy peer crash thresholds.

implementationReadyDelta.priority: Resolve the ODA-to-local R2004 page field-role audit before any peer-inspired production edit; keep it as one bounded fast slice under PAR-14/7BE.
testMatrix: compressed and uncompressed page forms with deliberately distinct physical Page Size and stored Data size
one full page plus a short final logical page whose stored page includes full-page padding
section logical size and max decompressed page size with checked rounded allocation
an omitted zero-page/start-offset gap if the local map parser supports that profile
map/header physical-extent mismatch, truncated payload, checksum failure, and a following-page or section sentinel
assertions: only the logical section prefix is published; padding is not exposed to consumers
physical map/header extent and stored payload bounds are validated independently
no partial section publication on failure and same-reader retry remains safe
the selected parser version and actual production parseDataPage path are exercised
implementationReadyDelta.validation: Use source-generated in-memory data in the existing DWG reader-matrix/hardening owners; strict -Werror build, focused selector, compatibility check, owning CTest, receipt JSON validation, and scoped diff check only. Keep full suites/sanitizers at their existing composed checkpoint.
implementationReadyDelta.fixturePolicy: No external DWG/DXF fixture. Do not download the LibreDWG attachment. Use only an in-memory authored control or locally-from-scratch scratch artifact if a file-backed API is unavoidable.
